item.description: Frontier coding agents are becoming increasingly adept at 3D modeling. item.description: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. item.description: Humanoid mobility over complex terrain requires accurate foot placement and coordinated whole-body motion capable of robust adaptation. Reinforcement learning (RL) policies trained without motion references generalize well across terrains, yet eliciting effective whole-body coordination through reward design and exploration alone remains challenging. item.description: Recent advances in large language models and agentic workflows offer a new paradigm to early-stage structural design translating design intent into structural models.
